title: An O(1) exact store revision marker kept by triggers (needs Greg's decision: schema change and migration of every live store)
outcome: An O(1) exact store revision marker kept by triggers (needs Greg's decision: schema change and migration of every live store)
acceptance: Greg decided whether to take a durable schema change, with migration export and import of every live store, for a trigger-maintained store revision counter that `backup status` and `backup push` can compare with the newest copy's without copying the store; the decision is recorded here verbatim with its source

blockers.detail: Held until Greg decides; Engram::Fable puts it to him only if the copy-and-compare fast path of w-9e95e510f9e4 does not solve TermAl's trigger cost.
